Dating app for tonight

# A dating app for tonight — not for “sometime next week”

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

Most dating apps are built around a slow funnel: swipe for a week, match, exchange messages for a few days, then try to find a free evening that suits two calendars. If what you actually want is a drink with someone new this evening, that funnel is the wrong shape. This page explains what a dating app for tonight has to do differently, and how 2NIGHT does it.

## What “for tonight” means in practice

A tonight-first app needs three things a classic swipe app does not have. First, a notion of time : everyone you see has to be free in the same window you are, otherwise you are back to “maybe Thursday?”. Second, a notion of distance that is real : a match 40 km away is not a plan for tonight, it is a plan for a weekend. Third, a way to say what kind of night you want before anyone types “hey”.

2NIGHT is designed around exactly those three things. You go live with a one-line status (“free after 8, drinks and live music”), pick from categories such as drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee or a walk, and say whether you are open to dating, meeting friends, or both. Then the Tonight Feed shows the other people who are live within your radius.

## The nightly window

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

The default status is Tonight . It ends at the next 5 AM, when the nightly reset clears every stale status and the feed starts again. There is no timer invented for marketing: the countdown in the app counts toward that real deadline, and only shows a “closing soon” cue in the last three hours before 5 AM. If you would rather stay visible longer, you can choose 24 hours, or open a separate “Stay discoverable” control for 3 days, 1 week or always-on — those options exist for quieter cities and for travellers, and they are deliberately kept out of the main picker so the “who's out tonight” count stays honest.

Until you set a status you are invisible. You can still open the feed, but a banner reminds you that nobody can see you until you go live. One tap on “Hide me” takes you out of every feed immediately.

## Radius: from your street to the whole city

Distance is the second half of a same-night plan. In the filter sheet you set a maximum distance with a slider that starts at 1 km. How far it can reach depends on your membership: the free Silver tier sees people within 5 km, Gold extends that to 15 km, and Platinum Black opens it to 50 km. Other members never see your coordinates — the feed only returns a rounded distance in kilometres — and if you have not been live for about 30 days, your stored position is blurred to your city.

## Ping, match, meet

Swipe up (or tap the button) to ping someone; swipe down to pass. If they ping you back, it is a match and a chat opens. Free members get a nightly allowance of pings; Gold and Platinum Black members ping without limits. A match chat stays open for 48 hours — long enough to agree on a bar and a time, short enough that it does not turn into a pen-pal relationship. Gold and Platinum Black can relaunch an expired conversation; Silver members simply match again another night.

Two more tools help turn a match into a meeting. A Plan is a public “I'm going to X at Y, join me” that other members nearby can join, and it is the fastest way to get a small group together when a one-to-one drink feels like too much pressure. And every match can start a two-minute video call — peer-to-peer, never passing through our servers — which is a quick, low-commitment way to check that the person is who their photos say before you head out. Video calls are free for everyone during the launch period.

## What 2NIGHT does not do

Honesty matters more than a feature list on a page like this. 2NIGHT does not run background or identity checks and has no photo-verification badge; meeting in a public place, telling a friend where you are, and trusting your gut are still your real safety system. Nobody at 2NIGHT reads your chats, and the app does not scan messages for abusive language — which is exactly why the report button matters. You can report or block anyone from their profile or from the ⋯ menu in a chat; a block is instant, silent and works both ways, and every report is read by a person, usually within 24 hours and always within 72.

2NIGHT is also strictly 18+ (the age selector starts at 18), it runs on iPhone only, and it is opening city by city. If it is not live where you are yet, the waitlist at 2night.co is the way in.

## Who a tonight-first app is for

- People who decide at 7 pm that they would like company, and want an answer by 8.

- Anyone tired of week-long chats that never become a date.

- Newcomers to a city who do not yet have a circle to go out with.

- Travellers with one free evening somewhere new (see 2NIGHT for travelers ).

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. If you want a slower, profile-heavy search for a long-term partner, a traditional app is a perfectly good tool — our comparison of the best apps to meet people tonight is honest about where each one fits.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is 2NIGHT really for the same night?

Yes. Your status defaults to “Tonight” and expires at 5 AM, the feed only shows people who are currently live, and match chats close after 48 hours, so everything points toward meeting this evening rather than chatting for a week.

### Do I have to be out already to use it?

No. You go live from wherever you are — your sofa counts — and set a radius. What you see is other people who are also live tonight within that distance.

### Is 2NIGHT free?

Joining and meeting people is free (the Silver tier: 5 km radius, a nightly allowance of pings, one active plan). Paid Gold and Platinum Black memberships add unlimited pings, a wider radius and other perks; prices are shown in the app before anything is charged, and billing is handled by Apple.

### Is it on Android?

No. 2NIGHT is an iPhone app. There is no Android build and no Google Play listing.

### Does 2NIGHT verify profiles?

No. There is no identity check, no background check and no verification badge. Use the two-minute video call, meet in public and tell a friend your plans.

## Tonight, not tomorrow.

2NIGHT is available on iPhone and opens city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co and we will message you the moment it is live near you.

Spontaneous dating

# The spontaneous dating app: decide at 7 pm, meet by 9

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

“Spontaneous” is a word every dating app likes to use and almost none are built for. Spontaneity needs two people to be free at the same moment, close enough to reach each other, and clear about what they want to do. A swipe deck of everyone in a 100-mile region who might be free some day cannot give you that. 2NIGHT was built to.

## Why most apps kill spontaneity

The classic model separates matching from meeting by days. You match on Monday, the conversation drifts, and by the time someone suggests a place the momentum is gone. Research on choice overload aside, the practical problem is simpler: nothing in the product knows whether either of you is free right now. Availability is negotiated by hand, in chat, and that is where most plans die.

A spontaneous dating app has to make availability a first-class piece of data. On 2NIGHT it is the whole product: you are either live tonight or you are not in the feed.

## How 2NIGHT makes spontaneity the default

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

### 1. A status instead of a profile essay

Going live is one tap plus an optional line of text. You pick what you are up for from a short list — drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk, network — and whether you are open to dating, friends, or both. Your bio is capped at 150 characters and you can add up to six photos. The point is to be quick to read at 7 pm, not to be a résumé.

### 2. A feed that only shows people who are out

The Tonight Feed is filtered by the server on two things: whether a status is still valid (its “available until” time is in the future) and whether the person is inside your chosen distance. A “Tonight” status expires at the next 5 AM. There is a 24-hour option, and a separately labelled “Stay discoverable” section with 3-day, 1-week and always-on choices for people in quieter cities or on the road; those are kept out of the main picker on purpose so the count of people out tonight is not inflated.

### 3. A radius you actually control

The filter sheet has a max-distance slider that starts at 1 km. The ceiling depends on your tier: 5 km on the free Silver tier, 15 km on Gold, 50 km on Platinum Black. Nobody sees your exact location — the feed hands other members a rounded distance in kilometres, nothing more.

### 4. Ping, match, 48-hour chat

Ping someone you would like to meet; if they ping back, it is a match and a chat opens. Chats close after 48 hours, which is a feature rather than a limitation: it keeps the conversation pointed at a place and a time. Gold and Platinum Black members can relaunch an expired chat and ping without limits; Silver members have a nightly allowance of pings.

### 5. Plans, for when one-to-one feels like too much

Anyone can post a Plan — “rooftop bar on Rue X, 9 pm, come along” — and nearby members can join. Free members can have one active plan at a time. A plan is the lowest-pressure way to be spontaneous: you are not asking one person for a date, you are telling the neighbourhood where you will be.

### 6. A two-minute video call before you leave the house

From any match you can start a two-minute video call, peer-to-peer over WebRTC (we never hold the call). It is the fastest honest check that a person is who their photos say, and it is free for everyone during launch.

## Spontaneous does not mean careless

2NIGHT does not run background or identity checks and has no verification badge, so the usual rules apply harder, not softer: meet in a busy public place, tell a friend who you are meeting and where, keep your own way home, and leave the moment something feels off. You can block and report anyone from their profile or from the ⋯ menu in a chat. Blocking is instant, silent and mutual; reports are read by a person, with action normally within 24 hours and always within 72. The full procedure is on our Guidelines page.

Privacy is part of that promise. There is no ads SDK, no analytics SDK and no tracking in the app. We do not sell data. Precise location is used only while you are live and, after about 30 days without going live, your stored position is blurred to your city. Your “who you want to see” preference is stored only if you give explicit consent and is never shown to anyone.

## Who it is for — and who it is not for

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. If you are patiently looking for a long-term partner and prefer detailed profiles and prompts, a traditional app is a better fit, and we say so in our honest comparison of tonight-focused apps . If you are free this evening and would like to meet someone real before it ends, 2NIGHT is built for that impulse.

2NIGHT is an iPhone app, strictly 18+, free to join, and opening city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co to be told the moment it is live near you.

## Frequently asked questions

### What makes 2NIGHT a spontaneous dating app rather than a normal one?

Availability is built into the product: you only appear in the feed while you are live, the default status ends at 5 AM, the feed is filtered by a radius you set, and chats close after 48 hours. Everything nudges toward meeting tonight.

### Can I use it for friends, not only dates?

Yes. When you go live you choose whether you are open to dating, friends, both, or networking, and Plans are open gatherings anyone nearby can join.

### How far away are the people I see?

As far as your slider allows: 1 km up to 5 km on the free tier, up to 15 km on Gold and up to 50 km on Platinum Black. You see a rounded distance, never an address.

### What happens when a chat expires?

After 48 hours the conversation closes. Gold and Platinum Black members can relaunch it; Silver members can match again another night.

### Is there a verification badge?

No. 2NIGHT does not verify identity or photos. The two-minute video call, meeting in public and telling a friend are the honest substitutes.

## Tonight, not tomorrow.

2NIGHT is available on iPhone and opens city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co and we will message you the moment it is live near you.

Same-day dates

# What a same-day date app has to get right — and how 2NIGHT does it

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

A same-day date is a plan with a hard deadline: it has to be agreed, travelled to and enjoyed before the night ends. That constraint is why most dating apps are bad at it, and it is the design brief 2NIGHT was written against. Below is what the app actually does, feature by feature, with the limits stated plainly.

## The three problems of a same-day date

- Time. Both people need to be free in the same window. In most apps that is discovered by asking, days after matching.

- Distance. A same-day date has a travel budget of minutes, not hours. “Within 100 miles” is meaningless at 8 pm.

- Intent. A drink, dinner, a gig, a walk — the plan is easier to say yes to when it is specific.

## Time: the “Tonight” status

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

On 2NIGHT you are not browsing a permanent catalogue of profiles. You go live, and your status has an expiry the server enforces. “Tonight” runs until the next 5 AM, when the nightly cleanup removes every stale status and the feed resets. That is the real deadline the countdown in the app points to, and the “Tonight ends in…” cue only appears in the final three hours, when it is genuinely true. A 24-hour option exists, and a separate “Stay discoverable” control offers 3 days, 1 week or always-on for quieter cities and travellers — intentionally kept apart from the nightly choice so the “out tonight” count means what it says.

If you have not set a status, you are not in anybody's feed. You can still look, but a gold banner tells you that you are invisible until you go live. “Hide me” removes you instantly.

## Distance: a radius with a real ceiling

The filter sheet has a max-distance slider from 1 km up to your tier's cap — 5 km on the free Silver tier, 15 km on Gold, 50 km on Platinum Black. The feed is centred on your current location, or on any city you pick with Travel Mode (a Gold and Platinum Black feature). Other members only ever receive a rounded distance in kilometres; coordinates are never shared, and a stored location is snapped to the city centre after about 30 days of inactivity.

## Intent: categories and a one-line status

Going live asks what you are up for tonight — drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk or network — and whether you are open to dating, friends, both, or networking. You can add one line of text. Bios are capped at 150 characters and profiles carry up to six photos. Everything is built to be read in seconds by someone deciding whether to ping you before the bar fills up.

## From match to meeting

Ping the people you would like to meet (swipe up) or pass (swipe down). A mutual ping is a match and opens a chat. The chat stays open for 48 hours; Gold and Platinum Black can relaunch an expired one. Free members have a nightly allowance of pings and one active Plan; paid members ping without limits and get a weekly Boost, Super Pings and, on Platinum Black, priority placement in the feed and access to Black Events (an RSVP request, confirmed by a person — never a purchased ticket).

Two features exist specifically to shorten the distance between “matched” and “there”:

- Plans. Post where you will be and when; people nearby can join. It turns a same-day date into a same-day gathering when that is easier.

- Two-minute video call. Peer-to-peer, never routed through our servers, free for everyone during launch. Thirty seconds of video answers the question a hundred messages cannot.

## The honest limits

2NIGHT does not check identities, does not run background checks and has no verification badge. It does not read your chats and does not scan them for abuse; there is a check for phone numbers, social handles and links, but that is a membership rule about when contact details can be exchanged (free members cannot drop them into chat), not a safety filter. Reporting is how bad behaviour is caught: tap the shield on a profile, or use the ⋯ menu in a chat, pick one of three reasons, and a person reads it — usually within 24 hours, always within 72. Blocking is instant, silent and works both ways, and can be undone under Settings → Safety & privacy.

The rest is the same advice we would give for any first meeting: pick a busy public place, tell someone your plan, keep your own way home, and leave if anything feels wrong. Our Safety page goes deeper.

## Same-day date apps compared

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. Other products approach the same-day idea differently: Pure deletes ads and chats after 24 hours, Bounce runs short daily matching sessions in New York and picks the venue for you, and MeetTonight lets you post a date plan for the next 72 hours. We compare them side by side, with what we could and could not verify, in Best apps to meet people tonight (2026) .

2NIGHT is an iPhone app for adults 18 and over, free to join, launching city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co.

## Frequently asked questions

### How is a same-day date app different from Tinder?

Tinder shows a standing catalogue of profiles within a distance you choose and leaves timing to the chat. 2NIGHT only shows people who are live tonight within your radius, expires statuses at 5 AM and closes chats after 48 hours, so the product itself pushes toward meeting today.

### Can I set a date for tomorrow instead?

Your status can run for 24 hours, or longer via the “Stay discoverable” options, and a Plan can be posted for a later time. The default and the design, though, are for tonight.

### How close are the people in my feed?

Within the distance you set on the slider, which starts at 1 km and is capped by your tier: 5 km free, 15 km Gold, 50 km Platinum Black.

### Does the app pick a venue for us?

No. Unlike Bounce, 2NIGHT does not choose a bar for you. You agree on a place in chat or post a Plan with the venue and time.

### What does it cost?

Joining and meeting people is free. Paid Gold and Platinum Black memberships are billed by Apple and their prices are shown in the app before anything is charged.

## Tonight, not tomorrow.

2NIGHT is available on iPhone and opens city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co and we will message you the moment it is live near you.

Who's out tonight

# Who is out tonight near me? How to actually find out

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

“Who is out tonight near me?” is the question every restless evening starts with, and it is surprisingly hard to answer. Group chats say “soon”. Dating apps show people who might be free some week. Venue apps show places, not people. 2NIGHT exists to answer that one question directly: here are the people, within this distance, who are live right now and want to go out.

## Why the question is hard

Being “out” is a state that changes hour by hour, and almost no product models it. A profile that was created in March says nothing about whether its owner is free on a Tuesday in September. To answer “who's out tonight?” an app needs a live signal — something a person switches on this evening and that switches itself off when the night ends — plus an honest sense of distance.

## How 2NIGHT answers it

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

### The live signal: going live

You tap “Set status”, optionally write one line (“free from 9, up for a drink near the station”), choose what you are in the mood for — drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk, network — and whether you are open to dating, friends, both or networking. From that moment you are in the Tonight Feed of everyone inside your radius, and they are in yours.

### The switch-off: 5 AM

A “Tonight” status expires at the next 5 AM, when a nightly cleanup clears stale statuses and the feed resets. The in-app countdown counts toward that real time. There is a 24-hour option, and a separate “Stay discoverable” control (3 days, 1 week, always-on) meant for travellers and quieter cities; it is kept out of the main choice so that the count of people out tonight is not padded with people who are not.

### The radius

The feed is centred on your location — or a city you choose with Travel Mode on Gold and Platinum Black — and limited to the max distance you set on a slider that starts at 1 km. The ceiling is 5 km on the free tier, 15 km on Gold and 50 km on Platinum Black. You see rounded distances in kilometres; nobody sees coordinates.

### The header count

The feed header shows how many people are live near you right now. It is the real number returned with the feed, not a marketing figure, and on a quiet night in a new city it can be small. We would rather show you an honest three than a fake three hundred.

## From “who's out” to “let's go”

Seeing who is out is only useful if it turns into a plan. On 2NIGHT you ping people you would like to meet; a mutual ping is a match and opens a chat that stays open for 48 hours. You can also post or join a Plan — a specific place and time other members nearby can join — which is often the fastest route on a night when you would rather be with a small group than on a one-to-one date. Every match can start a two-minute peer-to-peer video call, free during launch, to check the person is real before you leave.

A few habits make the difference between a dead chat and a real meeting, and they are the same ones we describe in our guide to meeting people near you tonight : lead with a concrete suggestion rather than “hey”, name a public place and a time, and keep it light.

## What you will not find on 2NIGHT

- Venue listings or event tickets. 2NIGHT is about people, not places. (An unrelated Italian app called “2night” lists bars and parties in Italian cities; that is not us.)

- Verified badges or background checks. We do not check identities. Meet in public and tell a friend.

- Precise locations. Distances are rounded; your stored position is blurred to your city after about 30 days of not going live.

- Trackers. No ads SDK, no analytics SDK, nothing sold.

## Safety when meeting someone who is out tonight

Same-night meetings are exciting precisely because they are quick, so keep the basics automatic: busy, well-lit public place; a friend who knows where you are; your own way home; never send money to anyone you met in the app; leave if your gut says so. Anyone who makes you uncomfortable can be blocked (instant, silent, both ways) and reported (three reasons, read by a person within 24–72 hours) from their profile or the ⋯ menu in a chat. Details are on our Guidelines page.

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. 2NIGHT is an iPhone app, 18+, free to join, opening city by city. If your city is not live yet, join the waitlist at 2night.co.

## Frequently asked questions

### Does 2NIGHT show everyone near me, or only people who are out?

Only people whose status is currently live. Someone who has not gone live tonight is not in the feed, and neither are you until you set a status.

### How near is “near me”?

Whatever you set on the distance slider, from 1 km up to your tier's cap: 5 km on the free Silver tier, 15 km on Gold, 50 km on Platinum Black.

### Can people see exactly where I am?

No. Other members receive a rounded distance in kilometres. Coordinates are never shared, and your stored location is blurred to your city after about 30 days of inactivity.

### What if nobody is out near me tonight?

The header count is honest, so on a quiet night it may be low. You can widen your radius (within your tier), post a Plan so people find you, or choose a longer visibility so you are discoverable when others go live.

### Is this the Italian nightlife app called 2night?

No. 2NIGHT (2night.co) is a one-night dating app for iPhone made in Switzerland. The Italian 2night lists venues and events in Italian cities and is unrelated.

## Tonight, not tomorrow.

2NIGHT is available on iPhone and opens city by city. Join the waitlist at 2night.co and we will message you the moment it is live near you.

Tinder alternative

# A Tinder alternative for tonight: what changes when the app is built for one evening

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

Tinder is very good at what it was built for: a huge pool, a fast swipe, and a match that may become a date at some point. If your goal is a date tonight , though, its shape works against you — the pool is wide, the timing is unknown, and the chat is where plans go to fade. This page is for people searching for a Tinder alternative that starts from the evening, not the profile. 2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date.

## The structural difference

Tinder's unit is the profile: it exists whether or not you are free, and the distance filter reaches up to roughly 160 km. Its paid tiers — Plus, Gold and Platinum — add unlimited likes, Passport, seeing who liked you, Top Picks and priority likes; list prices in the United States run from about $24.99 to $49.99 a month and vary by age and location. Tinder offers optional Photo Verification with a video selfie and, in some markets, ID verification.

2NIGHT's unit is the night. 2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. Where Tinder answers “who might I like?”, 2NIGHT answers “who is out, near me, right now — and what are they up for?”.

## Side by side

| What | Tinder | 2NIGHT |

| Built for | Ongoing matching, any timeline | Meeting the same night |

| Who you see | Profiles within your distance setting, free or not | People who are live tonight within your radius |

| Time limit | None on profiles or chats | Status ends at 5 AM by default; chats close after 48 h |

| Radius | Up to ~160 km (100 mi), Passport to any city on paid tiers | 1 km up to 5 km free, 15 km Gold, 50 km Platinum Black; Travel Mode on paid tiers |

| Intent | Relationship-goal tags on profile | Tonight's categories and a one-line status, reset nightly |

| Verification | Optional Photo Verification; ID verification in some markets | None — no badge, no identity checks |

| Group option | No | Plans anyone nearby can join |

| Video | Video chat has been offered in the past; current availability not verified | 2-minute peer-to-peer call from any match, free during launch |

| Platforms | iOS, Android, web | iPhone only |

| Price | Free with limits; Plus / Gold / Platinum from ~$24.99–$49.99 per month (US, varies) | Free to join; Gold and Platinum Black billed by Apple, prices shown in the app |

| Ads & tracking | Ads on the free tier; SDKs not verified | No ads, no analytics SDK, no data sold |

## What you gain by switching for a night

- Shared availability by default. Everyone in the feed went live tonight. The hardest part of any plan is solved before the first message.

- A radius that means something. Five kilometres is a walk or a short ride. You are never shown someone you could not realistically meet before closing time.

- A conversation with a deadline. Forty-eight hours is enough to pick a bar; it is not enough to become pen-pals.

- Plans. When a one-to-one date feels like a lot, post where you will be and let people join.

- A video check. Two minutes of video, device to device, before you leave the house.

## What you give up — honestly

- Scale. Tinder is everywhere. 2NIGHT is opening city by city and, on a quiet night in a small city, the honest header count may be low.

- Verification. Tinder's photo and ID checks are optional but real. 2NIGHT has none; your judgement is the safety system, and we say so on every page.

- Android and web. 2NIGHT is iPhone only.

- Deep profiles. If you want to filter on values and lifestyle before meeting, Tinder's and Bumble's profiles do more. 2NIGHT gives you 150 characters, six photos, tonight's categories and a status line.

## Safety and moderation on 2NIGHT

Report from a profile (the shield icon) or from the ⋯ menu in a chat, with one of three reasons; a person reads every report, usually within 24 hours and always within 72, and may remove the account, warn it or close the report. Reports are confidential by design — no member, including the reporter, can read them back. Blocking is instant, silent and mutual, reversible under Settings → Safety & privacy. Nobody reads your chats, and messages are deleted with your account. There is no background check; meet in public and tell a friend.

## Using both

It is not either/or. Plenty of people will keep a Tinder profile for the slow search and open 2NIGHT on the evenings they want company now. If you want the wider picture, including Bumble, Happn, Pure, Bounce, MeetTonight and what happened to Thursday, read Best apps to meet people tonight (2026) , or the focused 2NIGHT vs Tinder page.

2NIGHT is free to join, 18+, and on iPhone. Join the waitlist at 2night.co to be told when it opens in your city.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is 2NIGHT a replacement for Tinder?

For a same-night date, yes — that is what it is built for. For a slow, profile-led search for a long-term partner, Tinder or Bumble remain better tools. Many people will use both.

### Does 2NIGHT have something like Tinder Passport?

Yes: Travel Mode, on the Gold and Platinum Black tiers, lets you set your status in any city before you arrive.

### Does 2NIGHT verify photos like Tinder?

No. There is no photo or ID verification and no badge. The two-minute video call is the practical substitute.

### How much does 2NIGHT cost compared with Tinder?

Joining and meeting people on 2NIGHT is free. Gold and Platinum Black memberships are billed by Apple and their prices are shown in the app before you pay. Tinder's US list prices run from about $24.99 to $49.99 a month and vary by age and location.

### Is 2NIGHT on Android?

No, iPhone only. Tinder is on iOS, Android and the web.

How it works

# How 2NIGHT works, step by step

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

This is the plain, complete description of what happens inside 2NIGHT — from creating an account to hiding yourself at the end of the night — written from the app's own code rather than from a pitch deck. Where a feature depends on a paid tier, it says so. Where the app does not do something people often assume dating apps do, it says that too.

## 1. Account and sign-in

You sign in with Apple or with an email code (a one-time passcode; no password to remember). Onboarding asks for a first name, an age (the selector starts at 18 — 2NIGHT is strictly for adults), a gender, up to six photos, a bio of at most 150 characters, and the kind of nights you are into. When you save a bio, it is checked against a short list of prohibited terms and refused if it matches; that is a narrow filter for the worst slurs, not a content-moderation system.

Optionally you can set who you want to see (everyone, women, men, non-binary people). Because that choice can reveal sexual orientation, it is stored on our servers only if you tick an explicit consent box; “Everyone” stores nothing at all. It is never shown to any other member.

## 2. Going live

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

The feed opens with a banner saying you are invisible until you set a status. Tap Set status , choose what you are up for — drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk, network — say whether you are open to dating, friends, both or networking, and add one optional line of text. Then choose how long to stay visible:

- Tonight (default): until the next 5 AM, when the nightly cleanup clears all stale statuses and the feed resets.

- 24 hours.

- Stay discoverable — a separate, clearly labelled control with 3 days, 1 week and always-on. These exist for travellers and quieter cities and are deliberately not shown as equals of “Tonight”, so the count of people out tonight stays truthful.

Once live, the header shows a “Live until HH:MM” chip and a Hide me button. Hiding takes you out of every feed immediately. The countdown you see near the end of the night counts toward the real 5 AM reset and only appears in the last three hours.

## 3. Location and radius

The feed is centred on your phone's location, read at roughly kilometre accuracy. Other members receive only a rounded distance in kilometres from the server; coordinates are never sent to anyone. If you do not go live for about 30 days, your stored position is snapped to your city's centre.

In the filter sheet, a Max distance slider runs from 1 km up to the cap for your tier: 5 km on Silver (free), 15 km on Gold, 50 km on Platinum Black. Gold and Platinum Black also have Travel Mode : search for any city and set your status there before you land; the feed re-centres on it.

## 4. The Tonight Feed

The feed is a deck of people who are live within your distance, optionally narrowed to a category. Swipe up or tap the button to ping ; swipe down to pass . Silver members get a nightly allowance of free pings and can buy more; Gold and Platinum Black ping without limits. Gold and Platinum Black can also undo a pass. The header shows the real number of people currently live near you — never a fixed marketing figure. A “Likes you” view lists people who have pinged you; on Silver it is blurred.

## 5. Match and chat

A mutual ping is a match: a popup appears and a chat opens. The chat has a 48-hour window. When it expires it closes; Gold and Platinum Black can relaunch an expired conversation from a “past matches” list, while Silver members match again another night. Inside a chat you can send text, a photo like with a note, short video messages, and — on Gold and Platinum Black — private albums that the recipient can view a limited number of times.

There is a contact-details check on messages: free members cannot send phone numbers, social handles, emails or links, and phone numbers can only be exchanged between paid members. That is a membership rule, not a safety filter; nobody at 2NIGHT reads chats and the app does not scan them for abusive language.

Any match can start a two-minute video or voice call . Calls run peer-to-peer over WebRTC directly between the two phones and never pass through our servers (which also means, as on any peer-to-peer call, each side can technically see the other's IP address). Calls are free for everyone during the launch period.

## 6. Plans

A Plan is a public invitation: a place, a time, a short description. Members nearby see it in the Plans tab and can ask to join; the host can remove someone. Free members can have one active plan; some plans require Gold to join. If someone in a plan has blocked you, or you them, the plan simply shows as unavailable — the app never reveals who is where.

## 7. Memberships and extras

2NIGHT is free to join and free to meet people. Three tiers exist: Silver (free), Gold and Platinum Black . Gold adds unlimited pings, the 15 km radius, a free Boost every week, Super Pings, Travel Mode, two private albums and chat relaunch. Platinum Black adds the 50 km radius, priority placement in the feed, three private albums plus a 50-second video, and access to Black Events — invitation-style evenings where a reservation is an RSVP request confirmed by a person, never a purchased ticket. Boosts and Super Pings can also be bought individually. All billing is handled by Apple, renews until cancelled, and every price is shown in the app before anything is charged.

## 8. Safety tools

Report someone from their profile (the shield icon) or from the ⋯ menu in a chat, choosing inappropriate content, fake or scam, or harassment. Reports are confidential — no member, including the reporter, can read them back — and are reviewed by a person, usually within 24 hours and always within 72; the outcome is removal, a warning or closure, and every decision can be appealed by email. Block from the same two places: blocks are instant, silent and mutual, and reversible under Settings → Safety & privacy. There are no background or identity checks and no verification badge.

## 9. Your data

Data lives in Supabase (processed primarily in the EU); Apple handles sign-in, billing and push notifications. There is no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK in the app and nothing is sold. You can export a copy of your data and delete your account from Settings; messages are deleted with the account. Details: Privacy Policy , Trust & Security .

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. 2NIGHT is iPhone-only and opens city by city — join the waitlist at 2night.co.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I have to be live to see the feed?

You can open the feed without a status, but you are invisible to everyone else until you set one. A banner reminds you.

### When does my status end?

“Tonight” ends at the next 5 AM. You can choose 24 hours instead, or the separate Stay discoverable options (3 days, 1 week, always-on), and you can hide yourself at any time with one tap.

### How does matching work?

Ping someone you would like to meet. If they ping you back, it is a match and a chat opens for 48 hours.

### Can I share my phone number in chat?

Free members cannot send phone numbers, social handles, emails or links in chat; phone numbers can be exchanged between paid members. You can always agree on a place and a time in the chat itself.

### Does 2NIGHT verify users?

No. There are no identity checks, no background checks and no verification badge. Use the two-minute video call, meet in public and tell a friend.

### Is 2NIGHT on Android?

No. It is an iPhone app.

Comparison

# 2NIGHT vs Tinder: two different ideas of when a date happens

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. Tinder is the largest dating app in the world and it is not going anywhere. The question this page answers is narrower: on an evening when you want to meet someone tonight , which of the two is built for it, and what do you trade away?

## The core difference

Tinder's model is a standing catalogue. Profiles are permanent, the distance filter reaches up to roughly 160 km (100 miles), and whether the person is free this evening is something you find out by asking. 2NIGHT's model is a night: 2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

## Feature by feature

| Feature | Tinder | 2NIGHT |

| Same-night focus | No time dimension; profiles and chats persist | Status expires at 5 AM; chats close after 48 h; feed shows only people live tonight |

| Location radius | Distance filter up to ~160 km; Passport (paid) to browse any city | Slider from 1 km to 5 km (free), 15 km (Gold), 50 km (Platinum Black); Travel Mode on paid tiers |

| Matching model | Swipe right/left; mutual like = match; Platinum can message before matching | Ping/pass; mutual ping = match; Super Ping to stand out; no messaging before a match |

| Intent signal | Relationship-goal and interest tags on profile | Tonight's categories (drinks, food, music…) plus dating / friends / both, reset nightly |

| Group meets | No | Plans: post a place and time, nearby members join |

| Video | In-app video chat has existed; current availability not verified | 2-minute peer-to-peer video/voice call from any match; free during launch |

| Verification | Optional Photo Verification (video selfie); ID verification in select markets; badges | None. No badge, no identity or background checks |

| Report / block | Yes; Tinder has a large trust-and-safety operation | Yes; three report reasons, human review within 24–72 h; blocks instant, silent, mutual |

| Chat scanning | Tinder states it uses automated tools to detect harmful messages (details not verified) | None; chats are not read or scanned for abuse. Contact-details check is a membership rule |

| Price | Free with limits and ads; Plus ~$24.99, Gold ~$39.99, Platinum ~$49.99 per month (US list, varies by age/location) | Free to join; Gold and Platinum Black billed by Apple, prices shown in the app; no ads |

| Platforms | iOS, Android, web | iPhone only |

| Availability | Worldwide | Launching city by city; waitlist |

| Tracking | Not verified | No analytics or ads SDK; no data sold |

## Where Tinder is better

- Reach. Tinder is live in essentially every city on earth. On 2NIGHT the header count is honest and can be small while a city is opening.

- Verification and moderation scale. Optional photo and ID verification, and a large safety team. 2NIGHT's safety queue is read by a person, but there is no verification at all.

- Profile depth. If you want to filter on lifestyle, values and prompts before meeting, Tinder gives you far more than 150 characters and six photos.

- Platforms. Android and web.

## Where 2NIGHT is better

- Timing is solved by design. Everyone in the feed went live tonight. No “are you free this week?”.

- Distance you can act on. A 5 km radius is a plan; a 160 km one is a wish list.

- Chats with a deadline. 48 hours to name a place. Then it closes.

- Plans. A public invitation nearby people can join — there is no equivalent on Tinder.

- Privacy posture. No ads, no analytics SDK, rounded distances only, location blurred after 30 days idle, chats deleted with the account.

## Price, honestly

Both apps are free to use with limits. Tinder's paid tiers add unlimited likes, Passport, rewinds, seeing who liked you and priority likes; its prices vary by age and country and are best checked in the app. 2NIGHT's free Silver tier includes a nightly allowance of pings, a 5 km radius and one active plan; Gold adds unlimited pings, 15 km, a weekly Boost, Super Pings, Travel Mode, private albums and chat relaunch; Platinum Black adds 50 km, priority placement and Black Events. Every 2NIGHT price is shown in the app before you pay, and we do not publish numbers here so that this page cannot go stale or contradict your storefront.

## Verdict

Use Tinder for the wide, slow search. Use 2NIGHT on the evening you want to be out with someone real before the night is over. Many people will do both, and that is fine. Related reading: a Tinder alternative for tonight and our 2026 comparison of tonight-focused apps .

Tinder facts are taken from Tinder's help centre (subscriptions; Photo Verification; ID + Photo Verification) and from 2026 pricing round-ups by Android Authority and SwipeStats; prices are US list prices and change. Anything we could not confirm is marked “not verified”.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is 2NIGHT just Tinder for hookups?

No. 2NIGHT is a same-night meeting app: you say what you are up for tonight (drinks, food, music, a walk…) and whether you are open to dating, friends or both. It is about being out tonight, not about a specific kind of encounter.

### Does 2NIGHT have Passport like Tinder?

Travel Mode on Gold and Platinum Black lets you set your status in any city before you arrive; the feed re-centres on that city.

### Which app is safer?

Tinder offers optional photo and ID verification and has a large safety team; 2NIGHT has neither verification nor automated chat scanning, but has human-reviewed reports, silent mutual blocking, a two-minute video call and a strong privacy posture. On both, the real safety system is meeting in public and telling a friend.

### Can I use 2NIGHT on Android or on the web?

No. 2NIGHT is iPhone only. Tinder runs on iOS, Android and the web.

Comparison

# 2NIGHT vs Happn: crossed paths in the past, or out together tonight?

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. Happn is the closest of the big apps to 2NIGHT in spirit, because both are built on proximity. The difference is when . Happn shows you people you have physically crossed paths with — a timeline of the past. 2NIGHT shows you people who are live near you right now — a feed of tonight.

## How each one uses location

Happn keeps location running in the background and logs an encounter whenever another Happn user comes within roughly 250 metres of you. Those people appear on your timeline, with a count of how many times you crossed and roughly where. Like someone; if they like you back it is a “Crush” and you can chat. There is no time limit on the timeline or the chat.

2NIGHT reads your location only while you are live, at roughly kilometre accuracy. 2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. The distance is set by you on a slider from 1 km up to your tier's cap (5 km free, 15 km Gold, 50 km Platinum Black), and other members see only a rounded distance in kilometres. Gold and Platinum Black can also re-centre the feed on any city with Travel Mode.

## Side by side

| Feature | Happn | 2NIGHT |

| Same-night focus | No; timeline of past crossings, no expiry | Yes; status ends at 5 AM by default, chats close after 48 h |

| Location model | Background tracking; encounters within ~250 m | Location only while live; radius you set, 1–50 km depending on tier |

| Matching model | Like; mutual like = Crush; “FlashNote” style messages on paid plans (details not verified) | Ping/pass; mutual ping = match; Super Ping on paid tiers |

| Intent | Profile-based | Tonight's categories + dating / friends / both, reset nightly |

| Group meets | No | Plans nearby members can join |

| Video | Not verified | 2-minute peer-to-peer video/voice call, free during launch |

| Verification | Optional profile certification by short video selfie, with a badge | None |

| Privacy controls | Invisibility mode on paid plans (e.g. during work hours) | Hide me (one tap, free); location blurred to city after ~30 days idle; no trackers |

| Price | Free with limits; Premium around $24.99–$29.99 per month depending on region and source | Free to join; Gold and Platinum Black billed by Apple, prices in the app |

| Platforms | iOS, Android | iPhone only |

| Availability | Worldwide, strongest in Europe | Launching city by city; waitlist |

## What Happn does better

- Serendipity. Seeing that you passed the same person three times outside the same bakery is a genuinely good conversation starter, and no other app has it.

- Verification. Happn's video certification gives you a badge; 2NIGHT has no verification at all.

- Scale and Android. Happn is established across Europe and beyond, on both platforms.

## What 2NIGHT does better

- Present tense. Happn tells you who was near you; 2NIGHT tells you who is out near you tonight and what they are up for.

- No background tracking. Happn's model needs your location running in the background. 2NIGHT uses it only while you are live, and you can hide yourself with one tap for free.

- A deadline. Statuses reset at 5 AM and chats close after 48 hours, so conversations turn into plans or end.

- Plans and video. A public invitation nearby people can join, and a two-minute video call to check someone is real.

## Which one for which night

If you enjoy the idea of reconnecting with the person you keep seeing on your commute, and you are happy for that to take a few days, Happn is the right tool. If it is 7 pm, you are free and you would like to meet someone before midnight, 2NIGHT is built for exactly that. For the wider field, including Tinder, Bumble, Pure, Bounce and MeetTonight, see Best apps to meet people tonight (2026) .

2NIGHT is free to join, 18+, iPhone only; join the waitlist at 2night.co.

Happn facts are taken from Happn's Google Play listing and from 2026 reviews by SwipeStats, VIDA Select and DatingNav. Prices vary by region and change; anything unconfirmed is marked “not verified”.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is 2NIGHT like Happn?

Both use proximity, but Happn shows people you crossed paths with in the past while 2NIGHT shows people who are live near you tonight, within a radius you set.

### Does 2NIGHT track my location in the background?

No. Location is used only while you are live, at roughly kilometre accuracy, and other members see only a rounded distance. After about 30 days without going live your stored position is blurred to your city.

### Does 2NIGHT have a verification badge like Happn?

No. 2NIGHT does not verify identity or photos. The two-minute video call is the practical alternative.

### Which is cheaper?

Both are free to use with limits. Happn Premium is reported around $24.99–$29.99 a month depending on region; 2NIGHT's Gold and Platinum Black prices are shown in the app before you pay.

Comparison

# 2NIGHT vs Pure: two ways to keep a dating app short-lived

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. Pure and 2NIGHT share one conviction: a dating app should not be a place you live in. Pure achieves that with disappearing ads and chats; 2NIGHT with a status that ends at 5 AM and a feed of people who are out tonight. Beyond that shared idea, they are quite different products.

## How Pure works

Pure is built around personal ads , not profiles. To see other people you post an ad saying what you are looking for; ads and profiles are deleted after 24 hours, chats self-destruct after a day, and photos disappear after being viewed. Posting can be anonymous. Pure verifies that users are over 18 with a two-step check (face scan plus government ID) run by Veriff, and blocks screenshots. Most features require a subscription for men — around $13.49 a week, $29.99 a month or $79.99 a year according to 2026 reviews — while women can use the app free and pay for a separate “Pure Queens” tier. It runs on iOS, Android and the web.

## How 2NIGHT works

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. You go live with a category (drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk, network), an intention (dating, friends, both, networking) and one line of text. You set a max distance from 1 km up to 5 km on the free tier, 15 km on Gold or 50 km on Platinum Black. Ping people; a mutual ping opens a 48-hour chat. You can also post a Plan others can join, and start a two-minute peer-to-peer video call from any match. There is no verification and no anonymity: profiles carry a first name, age and photos.

## Side by side

| Feature | Pure | 2NIGHT |

| Same-night focus | Ads and profiles expire after 24 h; chats self-destruct after 24 h | Status ends at 5 AM by default; chats close after 48 h; feed shows only people live tonight |

| Location radius | Location-based feed with filters; no published radius (not verified) | You set 1–5 km free, up to 15 km Gold, up to 50 km Platinum Black; rounded distances only |

| Matching model | Post an ad, receive/like responses, chat | Ping/pass on people live tonight; mutual ping = match |

| Anonymity | Anonymous ads possible | No; first name, age, photos, one-line status |

| Intent | Free-text ad | Category + dating / friends / both + one line |

| Group meets | No | Plans nearby members can join |

| Video | Self-destructing photos/videos; live calls not verified | 2-minute peer-to-peer video/voice call, free during launch |

| Verification | Age verification via face scan + government ID (Veriff) | None — age is self-declared; no identity checks |

| Screenshots | Blocked | Not blocked (private albums have limited views) |

| Price | Subscription required for most features for men (~$13.49/week, $29.99/month, $79.99/year per 2026 reviews); free for women, with a paid Queens tier | Free to join for everyone; Gold and Platinum Black optional, billed by Apple, prices shown in the app |

| Platforms | iOS, Android, web | iPhone only |

| Availability | Worldwide | Launching city by city; waitlist |

## What Pure does better

- Age verification. Pure's ID-backed check is real; 2NIGHT relies on a self-declared age (18+) and removes accounts it believes are underage.

- Anonymity and disappearing content. If you want to post without a name and have everything vanish, Pure is designed for that.

- Android and web.

## What 2NIGHT does better

- Free for everyone. Joining and meeting people is free regardless of gender; paid tiers add reach and convenience, not access.

- A feed of people actually out. Pure shows ads; 2NIGHT shows people who are live tonight within a distance you control, with the honest count in the header.

- Plans. Public invitations for a small group — useful when a one-to-one meeting is not the mood.

- A video check. Two minutes, device to device, before you go.

- Broader intent. Drinks, a gig, a walk, new friends — 2NIGHT is about being out tonight, not one kind of encounter.

## Which one for which night

If anonymity and disappearing content are the point, Pure is the more purpose-built tool. If you want to see who is out near you tonight, meet for a drink or a plan, and keep your privacy without hiding your face, 2NIGHT is built for that. Our wider 2026 comparison covers Tinder, Bumble, Happn, Bounce, MeetTonight and Thursday too.

2NIGHT is free to join, 18+, iPhone only; join the waitlist at 2night.co.

Pure facts are taken from Pure's Google Play listing and its press room, and from 2026 reviews by DatingScout and BestReviews. Prices vary by region and change; anything unconfirmed is marked “not verified”.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is 2NIGHT anonymous like Pure?

No. 2NIGHT profiles show a first name, age, photos and tonight's status. What is protected is your location (rounded distances only) and your data (no trackers, nothing sold).

### Does 2NIGHT verify age with an ID like Pure?

No. Age is self-declared (the selector starts at 18) and accounts believed to be underage are removed. There is no ID or photo verification.

### Do men have to pay on 2NIGHT?

No. Joining and meeting people is free for everyone. Gold and Platinum Black are optional and priced the same regardless of gender.

### Do chats disappear on 2NIGHT?

A match chat closes after 48 hours. Messages are kept while your account exists and deleted with it; they are not read or scanned for abuse.

Travel

# 2NIGHT for travelers: one evening, a new city, real people

By the 2NIGHT team
·
Updated 4 September 2026

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days.

Travel gives you the purest version of the problem 2NIGHT solves. You have one evening, you know nobody, and every “let's meet up sometime” is meaningless because you leave on Thursday. What you need is to know who is out near your hotel tonight — and a way to say hello that turns into a drink before midnight.

## Why tonight-first fits travel

2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. For a traveller that is exactly the right shape. You do not need a week of chat with someone who lives in the city; you need the three people who are also free tonight within walking distance of where you are standing. The feed's header count is honest, so you also know immediately whether a quiet Tuesday in a small city is worth waiting on or whether it is time to widen the radius.

## Travel Mode: go live before you land

On the Gold and Platinum Black tiers, Travel Mode lets you search for any city and set your status there before you arrive. The Tonight Feed re-centres on that city, so you can see who is out in Lisbon while you are still on the train from Porto, and land with a plan instead of a blank evening. The city you pick is stored with your status; when you go back to your real location, one tap on “Use my current location” resets it.

On the free Silver tier there is no Travel Mode, but the app still works the moment you are physically there: go live from the hotel and the feed is your neighbourhood.

## Visibility that fits a trip

A “Tonight” status ends at 5 AM, which is perfect for one night out. If you are somewhere for a few days, the “Stay discoverable” control offers 3 days, 1 week or always-on, so you do not have to remember to go live every evening. Those longer options are shown separately from the nightly choice on purpose — they are useful for travellers and quieter cities, and keeping them apart is how the “out tonight” count stays truthful. Whatever you choose, “Hide me” takes you out of every feed in one tap.

## Set the radius for the city you are in

The max-distance slider starts at 1 km and is capped at 5 km on Silver, 15 km on Gold and 50 km on Platinum Black. A few practical rules from cities we know:

- Dense centre (Paris, Lisbon, Barcelona, Zürich): 2–3 km is plenty and keeps every match walkable.

- Spread-out city (Los Angeles, Berlin, the Swiss lakeside towns): 10–15 km on Gold, and lead with a specific neighbourhood in your status line.

- Small town or off-season resort: go wide, choose a longer visibility, and post a Plan so people come to you.

Whatever the radius, other members only see a rounded distance in kilometres, never your hotel's coordinates, and your stored position is blurred to the city centre after about 30 days without going live.

## Plans: let the city come to you

A Plan is a public invitation — “rooftop bar by the cathedral, 9:30, come say hi” — that nearby members can join. For a traveller it is often better than a one-to-one date: it is lower pressure, it can bring two or three people together, and it works even when you are not sure yet what you want the night to be. Free members can have one active plan at a time; Gold and Platinum Black can have more, and some plans require Gold to join.

## The two-minute video call

Any match can start a two-minute video or voice call, device to device over WebRTC (it never passes through our servers). Abroad, that is worth more than at home: it confirms a real person, checks the language works, and lets you agree a place in half a minute. It is free for everyone during launch.

## Safety when you are far from home

2NIGHT does not verify identities and runs no background checks, so the ordinary rules apply, plus a few travel-specific ones:

- Meet in a busy public place you can find your own way back from — not your accommodation, not theirs.

- Tell someone at home your plan, the person's first name and the venue; share your live location with them if you can.

- Keep your passport at the hotel and enough local cash for a taxi.

- Never send money, gift cards or crypto to anyone you met in the app, whatever the story.

- Block (instant, silent, mutual) and report (three reasons, read by a person within 24–72 hours) anyone who makes you uncomfortable — from their profile or the ⋯ menu in a chat.

Our guide to going out solo in a new city covers this in more depth.

## Availability

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date. 2NIGHT is an iPhone app for adults 18 and over, free to join, and it opens city by city; Travel Mode works in any city you can search for, but the people you see there depend on 2NIGHT having launched locally. Join the waitlist at 2night.co and we will tell you as cities open.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I use 2NIGHT before I arrive in a city?

Yes, with Travel Mode on the Gold and Platinum Black tiers: search for the city, set your status there, and the Tonight Feed re-centres on it. Free members go live once they are physically there.

### Does 2NIGHT work abroad?

The app works wherever your iPhone works, but the people you see depend on 2NIGHT having opened in that city. It launches city by city; the waitlist tells you when.

### How long can I stay visible on a trip?

“Tonight” ends at 5 AM. Under Stay discoverable you can choose 3 days, 1 week or always-on, and hide yourself at any time.

### Can people see which hotel I am in?

No. Other members only see a rounded distance in kilometres. Coordinates are never shared.

### Is 2NIGHT the Italian app that lists bars and events?

No. The Italian 2night (2night.it) is a venue and event guide. 2NIGHT at 2night.co is a Swiss-made one-night dating app for iPhone.

## App by app

### 2NIGHT

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days. 2NIGHT uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. It is free to join, has no ads or analytics SDK, does not verify identities, and is opening city by city on iPhone. Its weaknesses are the mirror of its strengths: no Android, no verification badge, and an honest header count that can be low while a city is new.

### Tinder

The largest pool anywhere, on every platform, with optional photo and ID verification. Nothing in the product knows whether a match is free tonight; that is negotiated in chat. Best for a wide, unhurried search. Paid tiers are priced dynamically, so check the app rather than any article.

### Bumble

Similar to Tinder with more emphasis on profiles and filters, Travel Mode on the paid tier, and — since August 2026 — no rule that women must message first. Like Tinder, it has no notion of tonight.

### Happn

Proximity in the past tense: people you physically crossed paths with, logged in the background. Charming, established in Europe, with video certification. Not designed for “who is free right now”, and it requires background location.

### Pure

The most radical of the disappearing-content apps: anonymous ads and chats that vanish after 24 hours, ID-backed age verification, screenshot blocking. Most features need a subscription for men. Best when anonymity is the point; less suited to “let's get a drink and see”.

### Bounce

The purest same-day mechanic: join a short daily session, say yes to someone who is looking at you at that moment, and the app books the venue. Strict on no-shows. As of this writing it is live in New York with other US cities listed as coming soon; pricing is not published.

### MeetTonight

A plan-first app: post a date idea for the next 72 hours or apply to someone else's, with verification and a free tier that allows one post a day. Closest in spirit to 2NIGHT's Plans. We could not verify platforms, radius or paid prices from its public pages.

### Thursday

The once-a-week app that proved people wanted scarcity, then closed its app on 10 January 2025 citing declining interest. The brand continues as ticketed Thursday Events; if you liked meeting in person at a fixed time, those events — or a Plan on 2NIGHT — are the successors.

## Which one for which situation

- It's 7 pm, I'm free, I want a drink with someone new tonight: 2NIGHT (if it is open in your city), Bounce (New York), Pure (if anonymity matters more than a face).

- I want to plan a specific date in the next couple of days: MeetTonight, or a Plan on 2NIGHT with a longer visibility.

- I'm looking for a long-term partner and don't mind a slow search: Tinder or Bumble; Happn if you like the crossed-paths idea.

- I'm travelling and know nobody: 2NIGHT with Travel Mode (paid) or simply going live where you are; Bumble's Travel Mode and Tinder's Passport for the slower version.

- I want a verified badge before I meet anyone: Tinder, Bumble, Happn or Pure. 2NIGHT has none; use its two-minute video call instead.

- I'd rather meet a small group than go on a date: 2NIGHT Plans, or Thursday Events in person.

- I'm on Android: everything except 2NIGHT.

2NIGHT is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date.

## Frequently asked questions

### Which app is best for meeting someone tonight?

It depends on where you are and what you want. 2NIGHT is built specifically for it and is free to join, but only where it has launched. Bounce works in New York, Pure if you want anonymity, MeetTonight if you prefer to post a date plan.

### Is Thursday still a dating app?

No. Thursday closed its app on 10 January 2025 and now runs ticketed in-person Thursday Events.

### Do any of these apps verify identity?

Tinder (photo, and ID in some markets), Bumble (photo), Happn (video certification) and Pure (ID-backed age check) offer verification. 2NIGHT does not; Bounce reviews profiles manually; MeetTonight offers verification by a method we could not confirm.

### Which apps are free?

All have a free tier except Pure, where most features need a subscription for men. 2NIGHT is free to join and meet people; paid tiers add radius and convenience.

### Which apps are on Android?

Tinder, Bumble, Happn, Pure and Bounce. 2NIGHT is iPhone only; MeetTonight's platforms are not verified.

Discover

# What is 2NIGHT?

The one-night dating app for people who decide at 7pm they want to meet someone — tonight, not tomorrow.

Most dating apps schedule a coffee three weeks out. 2NIGHT is built for the hours between now and 2 AM — the window where plans actually happen. Go live, see who's out near you, ping, match and meet.

## Built to get you out the door

01
### Go live in one tap
Set your status and the city sees you're free tonight. You control who, how far, and for how long.

02
### The Tonight Feed
Real people near you, free right now, wanting the same thing. No endless swiping toward someday.

03
### Ping, match, meet
Mutual interest opens a chat. Make a plan and meet — in person, the same night.

04
### Your radius, your night
Discover people within the distance you set — from your street to the whole city.

## The night, in detail

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days. It uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night.

Going live is one tap plus an optional line of text. You choose what you are up for — drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk or network — and whether you are open to dating, friends, both or networking. The default status ends at the next 5 AM, when the nightly cleanup clears every stale status and the feed resets; the countdown in the app points at that real time. A 24-hour option exists, and a separate “Stay discoverable” control offers 3 days, 1 week or always-on for travellers and quieter cities. Until you set a status you are invisible, and “Hide me” removes you from every feed in one tap.

## Your radius

The filter sheet has a max-distance slider that starts at 1 km. How far it reaches depends on your membership: 5 km on the free Silver tier, 15 km on Gold, 50 km on Platinum Black. Gold and Platinum Black also get Travel Mode — set your status in any city before you arrive and the feed re-centres there. Other members only see a rounded distance in kilometres; your coordinates are never shared.

## Ping, match, chat — with a deadline

Ping the people you would like to meet (swipe up) or pass (swipe down). A mutual ping is a match and opens a chat that stays open for 48 hours: long enough to pick a bar, short enough not to become a pen-pal. Free members have a nightly allowance of pings; Gold and Platinum Black ping without limits, can undo a pass, and can relaunch an expired chat. A “Likes you” view shows who has pinged you.

## Plans and the two-minute call

A Plan is a public invitation — a venue, a time, a line of text — that people nearby can join. It is the lowest-pressure way to go out on 2NIGHT: you are not asking one person for a date, you are telling the neighbourhood where you will be. Free members can have one active plan. From any match you can also start a two-minute video or voice call, peer-to-peer between the two phones, free for everyone during launch — a quick, honest check that a person is real before you leave.

## Memberships

2NIGHT is free to join and free to meet people. Gold adds unlimited pings, the 15 km radius, a free Boost every week, Super Pings, Travel Mode, two private albums and chat relaunch. Platinum Black adds the 50 km radius, priority placement in the feed, three private albums plus a 50-second video, and access to Black Events — evenings where a reservation is an RSVP request confirmed by a person, never a purchased ticket. All billing is by Apple, renews until cancelled, and every price is shown in the app before anything is charged.

## What 2NIGHT is not

It is not a venue guide (the unrelated Italian app called 2night is). It does not verify identities or photos, run background checks, or read or scan your chats; reports are reviewed by a person within 24–72 hours and blocks are instant and silent. It has no ads, no analytics SDK and sells no data. It is iPhone only, strictly 18+, and opening city by city.

About 2NIGHT

# Tonight, not tomorrow.

2NIGHT is for the moment you decide at 7pm that you actually want to do something — and want real people near you who feel the same.

The best nights aren't planned three weeks out. They happen because someone nearby is free right now and ready to move. We made the app that turns that impulse into a real plan — fast, in person, tonight.

## Two friends, one stubborn idea

Hugo & JericFounder & Associate · Switzerland

Hugo and Jeric, two friends from Switzerland, kept hitting the same wall: cities full of people, group chats full of “we should hang out soon,” and no one actually out tonight.

Hugo, the founder, writes the code. Jeric, his associate, runs the project and shapes the experience. From a Swiss kitchen table to wherever you're standing tonight — that's the whole story.

— Hugo & Jeric · Switzerland

## What 2NIGHT is

2NIGHT is a one-night dating app for iPhone that shows who is out near you tonight, so you can match and meet the same evening instead of chatting for days. It uses a radius around your location and a nightly “Tonight” status that expires at 5 AM; your profile only appears in the feed while you are live, next to other people who are out that night. It is an alternative to Tinder, Bumble, Happn and Pure for people who want a spontaneous same-night date — and it works just as well for a drink with new friends as for a date.

In practice that means: you go live with one line and a category (drinks, food, rooftop, music, culture, sports, games, nightlife, talk, coffee, walk or network), you set how far the night reaches with a slider from 1 km up to 5 km on the free tier, 15 km on Gold or 50 km on Platinum Black, you ping the people you would like to meet, and a mutual ping opens a chat that stays open for 48 hours. You can post a Plan that people nearby can join, and start a two-minute video call from any match before you leave the house. The full walkthrough is on How 2NIGHT works .

## What we believe

Tonight, not tomorrow. The best plans are the ones that happen in the next three hours. Every scarcity cue in the app — the count of people out near you, the countdown to 5 AM — points at a real deadline, never an invented one. The longer “stay discoverable” options exist for travellers and quiet cities, and they are kept apart from the nightly choice so the number of people out tonight means what it says.

Honest numbers. The feed header shows the real count returned by the server, even when it is three. The waitlist counter on this site is the real count from our own database. We do not publish invented testimonials and we do not publish prices we cannot guarantee for your storefront; every membership price is shown in the app, by Apple, before anything is charged.

Private by default. Other members see a rounded distance in kilometres, never your coordinates. Nobody at 2NIGHT reads your chats. There is no advertising, analytics or crash-reporting SDK in the app, and we do not sell data. Your “who you want to see” preference is stored only if you give explicit consent, because we treat it as the sensitive data it is. Details are on the Trust & Security page and in the Privacy Policy .

Say what we do not do. 2NIGHT does not run background or identity checks, has no verification badge, and does not scan messages for abuse. Reports are read by a person, usually within 24 hours and always within 72, and every decision can be appealed. We would rather tell you that on every page than let you assume otherwise.

## Who builds it

2NIGHT is a two-person project. Hugo writes the app (Swift, on iPhone only) and the backend; Jeric runs the project and shapes the experience. We are based in Switzerland, on the Geneva border, and the legal entity behind the app is listed on the legal notice . There are no investors and no growth team, which is why the honest header count and the absence of trackers are not marketing positions — they are simply how a small team that uses its own product wants it to work.

## Where 2NIGHT is available

2NIGHT runs on iPhone and is opening city by city. It is not yet available on the App Store; the waitlist on this site is the way in, and we message you the moment your city goes live. There is no Android version and no web version. The app is for adults 18 and over only.

## Not the Italian 2night

An unrelated Italian company also uses the name 2night: it publishes a guide to bars, restaurants and parties in Italian cities at 2night.it. That is not us and we are not affiliated. 2NIGHT at 2night.co is the one-night dating app described on this page.
